verdict.rationale: Angular ships an official CLI. Its documented commands create a new workspace (angular-docs-9) and build and serve the app with rebuild on file changes (angular-docs-10). The GitHub repo advertises getting started in 5 minutes (angular-gh-2), and an in-browser tutorial and playground let users try Angular without any setup (angular-docs-5, angular-docs-8). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scaffolding and first run actually take only a few minutes, since the community evidence does not address the CLI setup experience.
